hypothesis: Replacing only the imagination termination probability improves complete-motion control under the same physical task and budget
execution: sequential, fresh initialization, identical initial networks and Torch RNG verified
smoothing_choice: Fixed before training at 5 percent of each normalized physical threshold; no sweep
learned_termination_bce: Unchanged in both arms, including gradients through predicted states
physical_termination: Unchanged hard thresholds and natural motion endings
primary_evaluation: All 40 complete motions from first frame, same deterministic actor/noise/context/denominator, final 3-hour checkpoints
secondary_evaluation: All 1000-iteration milestones and common-iteration comparisons; best intermediate version reported separately
diagnostics: 120 fixed starts, 1/8/16/32-step prediction errors, all-sample and pre-failure counts, first-failure probability pairs, termination feature grids
publication: Every iteration atomic full checkpoint; keep recent 20 plus iteration zero and multiples of 1000; publish every 1000 and final
stop: Two 3-hour runs plus fixed evaluations; no automatic additional seeds, budget extension, reward changes, or horizon changes
inference_limit: Single-seed learning experiment; policy-dependent state distributions do not isolate world-model quality
